name: LEGO 3D ARTIFACT VR SIMULATOR
summary: An immersive virtual construction experience that allows users to assemble a LEGO-style car inside a fully interactive 3D environment. Using VR controllers, users can grab, align, and snap-fit components with precision while tracking real-time progress. Designed for education, training, and interactive engagement, this system transforms traditional building into an intuitive, hands-on digital experience.
